mapper.sql: FROM topic_media tm INNER JOIN media m ON m.id = tm.media_id AND m.status = 1 INNER JOIN location l ON l.id = m.location_id AND l.status = 1 INNER JOIN campus c ON c.id = l.campus_id AND c.status = 1 INNER JOIN city ci ON ci.id = c.city_id AND ci.status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_media WHERE topic_id = #{topicId}
SELECT media_id FROM topic_media WHERE topic_id = #{topicId} ORDER BY sort_order, media_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topic_media(topic_id, media_id, sort_order, created_at) VALUES(#{topicId}, #{mediaId}, #{sortOrder}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.title, m.location_id, l.name AS location_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.thumbnail_key, ''), m.object_key) AS thumbnail_key, m.shot_at, m.view_count, m.like_count, m.favorite_count
WHERE tm.topic_id = #{topicId} ORDER BY tm.sort_order, m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
